question: What is being counted in the Federal Reserve access queue?
answer: The saved queue measures count different application and account populations at stated dates. They are not a live total, and an approval, opened account and active use are separate events.

kv: 2025-12-12: Circle, Ripple, BitGo, Fidelity, Paxos. 2026: Bridge (Feb 12), National Digital Trust/Protego (Feb 13), Foris DAX/Crypto.com (Feb 20), Coinbase (Apr 2), Laser Digital (May 29), Morgan Stanley Digital Trust (Jun 18), Connectia/Sony (Jul 2), World Liberty (Aug 14), Bastion (Sep 18), Catena (Sep 18), Agora (Sep 18). catalog_context.title: Who actually controls the crypto infrastructure
catalog_context.answer: Of 20 crypto networks and companies we track, only one is used at scale and none is proven under stress; many brands rest on a handful of legal providers.
